title: Neural Speech Features V2.5
description: The format of the Data of a Speech Descriptors Object (MMC-SDO-V2.5): the JSON text of its inline Data, or of what its DataURI gives, with no Qualifier that carries the speech features of the emotion that Emotion Feature Production (CAE-EFP) produces for Neural Emotion Insertion (CAE-NEI). It replaces NeuralSpeechFeatures of CAE V2.1.
